title: Music Page & Releases

fields.label: Page intro line
fields.name: page_lede
fields.instructions: The sentence under the big “Music” heading.

fields.label: Your releases
fields.name: releases
fields.instructions: One row per release, newest first. Powers the Discography on Home, Music, and Press Kit, the Singles list, and each release’s own page.

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: Release title as it should appear everywhere.

sub_fields.label: Kind
sub_fields.name: kind
sub_fields.instructions: Albums and EPs go in the Discography; Singles go in the Singles list.

sub_fields.label: Its page on this dashboard
sub_fields.name: release_page
sub_fields.instructions: The WordPress page whose text and lyric images make up the release’s “About the Record” page.

sub_fields.label: Shop item
sub_fields.name: product
sub_fields.instructions: The shop product for the “Buy” button. Leave empty if it isn’t sold.

sub_fields.label: Spotify link
sub_fields.name: spotify_url
sub_fields.instructions: This release’s own Spotify link. Leave empty to use your artist profile link below.

sub_fields.label: Apple Music link
sub_fields.name: apple_url
sub_fields.instructions: This release’s own Apple Music link. Leave empty to use your artist profile link below.

fields.label: Your Spotify profile
fields.name: artist_spotify
fields.instructions: Used wherever a release doesn’t have its own link, and on the FYC “Listen” buttons.

fields.label: Your Apple Music profile
fields.name: artist_apple
fields.instructions: Used wherever a release doesn’t have its own link, and on the FYC “Listen” buttons.

fields.label: Browser-tab title
fields.name: meta_title
fields.instructions: What Google and the browser tab show for the Music page.

fields.label: Search description
fields.name: meta_description
fields.instructions: The sentence Google shows for the Music page.

description: The Music page intro plus the master list of releases. The page’s own text below stays your Liner Notes intro.
